A few good questions

Keep your
curiosity.

Is argue ready for people who hate arguing?+

Especially. The point isn’t to turn you into someone more combative. It’s to help you stay clear when the stakes make clarity difficult.

Is it a writing tool, a coaching tool, or both?+

A little of both. You’ll write things down, but the real work is noticing the structure underneath: what you know, what you need, and what you’re asking for.

When can I try it?+

We’re inviting a small first circle to shape the experience. Leave your email below and we’ll let you know when the doors open.
